He realizes no one knows the place better than he does, and he mounts his trusty steed, a Segway, and goes to the rescue.

Six years after he saved the day at his beloved New Jersey shopping mall, security guard Paul Blart (Kevin James) is taking a well-deserved vacation. In recognition for his hard work, he's won an all-expenses-paid trip to a security convention in Las Vegas, and decides to take his teenage daughter, Maya (Raini Rodriguez), with him. True to form, however, Paul just can't relax and take it easy, so when he uncovers a criminal threat to the hotel, he springs into action.

A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission.

The people of Detroit know 8 Mile as the city limit, a border, a boundary. It is also a psychological dividing line that separates Jimmy Smith Jr. (Eminem) from where and who he wants to be. A provocative fictional examination of a critical week in Jimmy's life.

Three best friends form a pop punk band and compete against rivals in the last Vans Warped Tour. While competing, they discover that the road to fame isn't easy between work, school and relationships.

Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems.
An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.
In 2002, jockey Damien Oliver (Stephen Curry) loses his brother in a tragic racetrack accident mere days before he's due to ride in Australia's prestigious Melbourne Cup.

When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.
A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

Ricky Hayman (Jeff Goldblum), an executive at a home shopping network, is on the verge of losing his job. Sales are down under his leadership, and his boss wants to replace him with his rival, Kate Newell (Kelly Preston). But then Ricky meets an interesting man named G (Eddie Murphy). On a whim, he puts G on camera, and sales begin skyrocketing. But, when the job starts to take its toll on G's formerly enlightened demeanor, Ricky begins to question whether he has done the right thing.

La sanadora holística Beatriz recibe una invitación amistosa a una cena de negocios después de que su auto se descompone. Pronto se encuentra en una creciente guerra con un magnate de bienes raíces despiadado.

Deacon, un agente de las fuerzas de élite, ya retirado, viaja a China para donar uno de sus riñones a su sobrina. Sin embargo, cae en la red de una mafia dedicada al robo de órganos. Ahora, para salvar la vida de su sobrina, tiene que capturar a los traficantes.
Un afligido actor conoce a excéntricos personajes mientras viaja por el desierto para entregar una misteriosa maleta.
Hong usa su visión moral y sus habilidades para pelear y salvar a un vecindario de los narcotraficantes y policías corruptos.
Un expresidiario decide investigar la muerte de su hija y descubre a un hombre mayor que fue su amante.
Un corresponsal de guerra y su camarógrafo quedan atrapados en el medio de una batalla entre Georgia y Rusia.
Una policía se da a la tarea de encontrar al psicópata que la involucró en una serie de asesinatos nocturnos.
Condenado a una prisión sudafricana durante 12 años, el activista anti-apartheid Tim Jenkin y sus compañeros de prisión idean un atrevido plan para escapar.

A desperate man takes part in an underworld game of Russian roulette in which gamblers place bets on who will survive.

Sometimes living or dying comes down to a matter of choice. It took Annabel (Eliza Dushku) and Matt (Wes Bentley) to help their shattered friend make that choice -- help that would prove a killer journey. A college freshman Cassandra Cassie (Melissa Sagemiller) steps into a nightmare of otherworldly visitations after surviving a devastating car accident.
Five strangers wake up in a sunken castle with no food, water or memories. They are forced to band together to complete the sinister adventure that awaits them.

When the wife and daughter of Army drill sergeant John North (Brian Bosworth) are killed during an arms deal involving a crooked FBI agent named Karl Savak (Bruce Payne), John decides to take matters into his own hands, only to discover that the henchman responsible for their deaths has been put into witness protection. Now, John must enlist the help of a street-smart kid named Mikey (DeJuan Guy) to infiltrate the city's criminal underground and get his own form of revenge.
When a criminal organization kills an Interpol agent's wife and daughter, he gets revenge.
A squad of six Black soldiers, led by ex-slave Barabbas, are sent on a suicide mission.

Having been forced to act as a body double for one of Saddam Hussein's sons, Latif Yahia gives an insider's look at the life of the Iraqi tyrant.

When her husband is attacked by a zombified neighbor, Ana (Sarah Polley) manages to escape, only to realize her entire Milwaukee neighborhood has been overrun by the walking dead. After being questioned by cautious policeman Kenneth (Ving Rhames), Ana joins him and a small group that gravitates to the local shopping mall as a bastion of safety. Once they convince suspicious security guards that they are not contaminated, the group bands together to fight the undead hordes.

A creepy mortician, Mr. Simms (Clarence Williams III), attempts to scare teenage drug dealer Stack (Joe Torry) and his friends straight by telling them four horrifying stories. One is about a guilt-riddled cop (Anthony Griffith) who goes crazy after ignoring his corrupt partner (Michael Massee). He also tells of a meek schoolboy (Brandon Hammond) with terrifying supernatural powers. Although the young thugs want to take their drugs and escape Mr. Simms, he still has two more tales to tell.
A series of bloodcurdling tales about lust, greed, pride and politics.

All Happy Gilmore (Adam Sandler) has ever wanted is to be a professional hockey player. But he soon discovers he may actually have a talent for playing an entirely different sport: golf. When his grandmother (Frances Bay) learns she is about to lose her home, Happy joins a golf tournament to try and win enough money to buy it for her. With his powerful driving skills and foulmouthed attitude, Happy becomes an unlikely golf hero -- much to the chagrin of the well-mannered golf professionals.

On a remote coastal island, a former assassin living in self-imposed exile rescues a young girl from a deadly storm. As their lives start to intertwine, he must protect the orphan while battling enemies from his past.

Kindhearted Griffin Keyes is one of the best-loved caretakers at the Franklin Park Zoo, but since he is more comfortable with the animals than with females of his own species, his love life is lacking. When Griffin decides that the only way to get a girlfriend is to find a more glamorous career, the animals panic. To keep him from leaving, they reveal their secret ability to talk and offer to teach him the rules of courtship, animal style.

Two orphans (Heather Rattray, Mark Edward Hall) follow a frontier con man (Robert Logan) over the Rockies to their Oregon inheritance.

Though most men are concerned with prospecting gold, American ranchers Jim Redfern and Mike Evans are trying to make a fortune by leading a long line of cattle from Montana to Canada. While they are resting one night, their herd is robbed by a gang of thugs, leaving the cowboys stranded in the wilderness without their livelihood. Jim and Mike then decide to try their hands at mining gold, but before long they run into the enemy bandits again.

One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe).
After receiving some unexpected news about herself, a teenager experiences a challenging and exciting time on the rodeo circuit.

Two years after being forcibly taken away from his California property by thugs working for his greedy cousin, Luerra (Anthony Warde), Don Ricardo (Fred Coby) returns to reclaim his ranch and his fiancée, Dorothea (Isabelita). After meeting old friend Lugo the Huge (Paul Newlan) in a cantina, Don Ricardo takes the advice of Padre Carlos (David Leonard) and gets a job on his land, disguised as a common laborer, biding his time until he can find evidence of Luerra's wrongdoing and challenge him.

p.t: John Wayne Behind-the-Scenes: Filming of Stunts, Chases, Fights, Crashes & Gun Battles
p.d: Rare production features, TV clips, and special promos provide a behind-the-scenes look at the stunts, fights, gun battles and chases from John Wayne movies including "Stagecoach," "War Wagon," "Brannigan" and "McLintock."
A frontier woman turns fugitive when she is wrongly accused of a crime she didn't commit and is hunted by a vengeful preacher.

Jim and Mike then decide to try their hands at mining gold, but before long they run into the enemy bandits again.
Mysterious drifter Johnny Ringo arrives in a small town to put an end to a ruthless counterfeiting gang, facing danger and deception along the way.

Samuel Alabaster, an affluent pioneer, ventures across the American frontier to marry the love of his life, Penelope. As his group traverses the West, the once-simple journey grows treacherous, blurring the lines between hero, villain and damsel.
A frontier woman turns fugitive when she is wrongly accused of a crime she didn't commit and is hunted by a vengeful preacher.

After newspaper reporter Cindy (Anna Faris) accidentally watches a strange videotape that causes the viewer to die within a week, she discovers the tape is only one of many weird happenings. Local farmers Tom (Charlie Sheen) and George (Simon Rex) have reported massive crop circles appearing overnight in their fields. Cindy finds a link between the tape and the crop circles with help from the U.S. president (Leslie Nielsen) and a kindly aunt (Queen Latifah).

Framed for a murder he did not commit, three-time speedway champ Jensen Ames (Jason Statham) finds himself at Terminal Island, the country's toughest prison, but he gets an unexpected chance at freedom when the warden offers a choice: Compete in the Death Race as a mythical driver called Frankenstein, or rot in a cell forever. Riding in a car equipped with flamethrowers and grenade launchers, Ames must survive a gauntlet of vicious criminals to win his freedom -- or die trying.
Convicted of killing a cop, an inmate (Luke Goss) competes in a brutal race where cars are deadly weapons.

When Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.) jump-starts a dormant peacekeeping program, things go terribly awry, forcing him, Thor (Chris Hemsworth), the Incredible Hulk (Mark Ruffalo) and the rest of the Avengers to reassemble. As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff.

Starr Carter is constantly switching between two worlds -- the poor, mostly black neighborhood where she lives and the wealthy, mostly white prep school that she attends. The uneasy balance between these worlds is soon shattered when she witnesses the fatal shooting of her childhood best friend at the hands of a police officer. Facing pressure from all sides of the community, Starr must find her voice and decide to stand up for what's right.

A woman and her daughter find warmth and companionship when her late husband's combat dog comes to live on their farm. However, they must soon band together when a corrupt sheriff does whatever it takes to get his hands on the family's land.

After years away from the cage, a once-feared 🥊 [MMA] MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. p.t: Now You See Me: Now You Don't
p.d: The Four Horsemen and a new generation of illusionists join forces to steal the world's largest diamond from a South African mogul who heads an international crime syndicate.

Under cover of night, vampires engage in an age-old battle with their sworn enemies, the Lycans, a clan of violent werewolves. Selene, a vampire orphaned in the wake of a bloody Lycan attack, works for the vampire clan as a trained killer. When the Lycans take a mysterious interest in Michael Corvin, an exceptional mortal doctor, Selene struggles to save him from Lucian, a ruthless Lycan leader hell-bent on ending the vampire bloodline.

After the death of Red Jacob, a new Laird of Clan MacKenzie must be chosen and both of his sons, Colum and Dougal, vie for the title; at the Gathering, Brian Fraser and Ellen MacKenzie meet and are struck by their strong connection.

Cuatro años después de la destrucción de la Isla Nublar, los dinosaurios viven y cazan junto a los humanos en todo el mundo. Este frágil equilibrio remodelará el futuro de la especie humana.

Unos científicos que investigan el océano liberan accidentalmente a un megalodón, un tiburón prehistórico gigante que se creía extinto hace millones de años. Ahora deberán arriesgar sus vidas para evitar una masacre en las costas del Pacífico.

Dos socorristas, el veterano Mitch Buchannon y el joven y arrogante Matt Brody, deben detener a unos criminales que amenazan el futuro de la bahía en la que trabajan. Mientras colaboran aprenderán a respetarse mutuamente, dado que el comienzo de su relación profesional ha sido complicado.

p.t: Nunca he estado en Nueva York
p.d: Un día, la madre de Lisa, María, tiene un accidente en el que pierde la memoria. Solo sabe que nunca ha estado en Nueva York. Quiere cambiar eso y se mete de contrabando en un crucero.

Grace Davis es una leyenda del mundo de la música que vive en la ciudad de Los Ángeles. Cuando el mánager de Grace intenta darle un giro a su carrera, Grace y su asistente personal, Maggie, tendrán que tomar una importante decisión.

Después de la repentina muerte de su esposo, Libby se ve obligada a mudarse a la granja de su tía en Texas. Mientras lucha por adaptarse a la vida en el campo, la joven viuda comienza a enamorarse del administrador de la granja.

Antoine es el Jefe de recursos humanos de una gran empresa. Cuando su mujer decide irse de vacaciones y dejarle con la responsabilidad de sus cuatro hijos, intuye que será fácil. Pero Antoine ha subestimado el lío que esto puede suponer.

Grace Davis es una leyenda del mundo de la música que vive en la ciudad de Los Ángeles. Cuando el mánager de Grace intenta darle un giro a su carrera, Grace y su asistente personal, Maggie, tendrán que tomar una importante decisión.

Después de la repentina muerte de su esposo, Libby se ve obligada a mudarse a la granja de su tía en Texas. Mientras lucha por adaptarse a la vida en el campo, la joven viuda comienza a enamorarse del administrador de la granja.
El excampeón del mundo de peso pesado Rocky Balboa se desempeña como el entrenador y mentor de Adonis Johnson, el hijo de su difunto amigo y antiguo rival Apollo Creed.

When they arrive at college, socially inept freshmen Larry (Thomas Hulce) and Kent (Stephen Furst) attempt to pledge the snooty Omega Theta Pi House, but are summarily rejected. Lowering their standards, they try at the notoriously rowdy Delta Tau Chi House, and get in. The trouble is, the college dean (John Vernon) has it in for the Deltas. He has put them on "Double Secret Probation" and secretly assigned Omega's president (James Daughton) the task of having their charter revoked.

Tripper is the head counselor at a budget summer camp called Camp Northstar. In truth, he's young at heart and only marginally more mature than the campers themselves. Tripper befriends Rudy, a loner camper who has trouble fitting in. As Tripper inspires his young charges to defeat rival Camp Mohawk in the annual Olympiad competition, Rudy plays matchmaker between Tripper and Roxanne, a female counselor at Northstar.

After his release from prison, Jake (John Belushi) reunites with his brother, Elwood (Dan Aykroyd) -- collectively known as the "Blues Brothers." Jake's first task is to save the orphanage the brothers grew up in from closing, by raising $5,000 to pay back taxes. The two are convinced they can earn the money by getting their old band back together. However, after playing several gigs and making a few enemies, including the police, the brothers face daunting odds to deliver the money on time.
Barney orders Gomer and Otis to keep watch on Andy when an ex-con Andy sent to prison many years before returns to Mayberry.
Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.
Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.
Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.
Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.
Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.
Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.
Andy unexpectedly has his hands full as The Darlings, a family of musicians from the mountains, arrive in Mayberry to meet a bus due the next day.
Malcolm Merriweather, an English tourist, passes by Mayberry on a bicycle; after causing a traffic accident, he agrees to work off the damages as Andy's personal valet.
Barney spends his life savings to buy a used car. Unbeknownst to him, the car is actually a lemon and has several issues and defects.
After Opie is struck with puppy love, Barney tries to show him how to handle women.

An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.
Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

In windy Canyon, Texas, Jess visits West Texas A&M, where she interacts with a cloned cow, participates in a blind meat tasting experiment, and helps teach us how to break down a carcass into the cuts we see in the grocery store.
Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

Mike Lane takes to the stage once again when a business deal that went bust leaves him broke and bartending in Florida. Hoping for one last hurrah, Mike heads to London with a wealthy socialite who lures him with an offer he can't refuse -- and an agenda all her own. With everything on the line, he soon finds himself trying to whip a hot new roster of talented dancers into shape.
Sal, Q and Murr flag down a Good Samaritan for help from their broken-down car, then impersonate corpses in a funeral home with Adam Ray.

The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

The Jokers pretend to be medical students in training with standardized patient actors, then play the hero and break up a public fight, hoping to earn applause; one Joker has to put his hips where his mouth is and settle a bet of his own making.

The Jokers are back playing lawyers, trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air. Later, one joker will be getting revenge in an elaborate punishment that the other two are really going to feel.

The Jokers are back pretending to be overnight watchmen who don't know when to call it quits, before rallying bystanders to take their side in an unlawful arrest; but one loser has to face a punishment that brings out his feminine side.
Michael invites the entire office to celebrate the christening of Pam and Jim's baby.
Erin and Gabe host a "Glee" viewing party; Michael is upset when people refer to Gabe as his boss; Andy becomes increasingly jealous.

Michael helps convince people to invest in Ryan's Internet company; trying to capitalize on Thanksgiving, Dwight creates a hay festival in the parking lot; a new policy prevents Jim from earning commission.
Michael decides he must stop China before it takes over the United States; Pam threatens to move the company to a new building.

Todd es un joven que teme a la soledad y, mientras intenta dejar atrás sus fantasmas, conoce a Rory, una joven con inseguridades, miedos y frustraciones.

Un recuento especial de la leyenda del rey Arturo, enfatizando la relación entre el rey, Ginebra y Lanzarote.
Dos ladrones forjan una relación sorprendente con una niñera cuando accidentalmente se ven atrapados en una casa en la que acaban de entrar.

Un antiguo detective sufre una estafa telefónica, al igual que algunos de sus compañeros y familiares, por lo que sigue la pista y se infiltra en la organización responsable del crimen, donde se encuentra con el cerebro que está detrás de la trampa.
Basada en la historia de Louisa May Alcott. Las hermanas March forman lazos emocionales durante la Guerra Civil.
Un comandante del ejército de Corea del Sur se hace pasar por un hombre de negocios para infiltrarse en una instalación nuclear de Corea del Norte en 1993.

Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. When a regiment of Mexican soldiers bearing gold is waylaid by the Rojo brothers, Joe is hired by Esteban to join the gang, but he plays one side against the other.

On an unforgiving, snow-swept frontier, a group of bloodthirsty bounty hunters, led by the vicious Loco, preys on a band of persecuted outlaws who have taken to the hills. As the price on each head is collected one-by-one, only a mute gunslinger named Silence stands between the innocent refugees and the greed and corruption that the bounty hunters represent. But in this harsh, brutal world, the lines between right and wrong aren't always clear and good doesn't always triumph.

Jesuit priest Father Gabriel enters the Guaraní lands in South America with the purpose of converting the natives to Christianity. He soon builds a mission, where he is joined by Rodrigo Mendoza, a reformed slave trader seeking redemption. When a treaty transfers the land from Spain to Portugal, the Portuguese government wants to capture the natives for slave labor. Mendoza and Gabriel resolve to defend the mission, but disagree on how to accomplish the task.

Paratrooper commander Colonel Mathieu (Jean Martin), a former French Resistance fighter during World War II, is sent to 1950s Algeria to reinforce efforts to squelch the uprisings of the Algerian War. There he faces Ali la Pointe (Brahim Haggiag), a former petty criminal who, as the leader of the Algerian Front de Libération Nationale, directs terror strategies against the colonial French government occupation. As each side resorts to ever-increasing brutality, no violent act is too unthinkable.

Scientist H.G. Wells builds a time machine, and despite the warning from his friend David against "tempting the laws of providence," decides to visit the future. Jumping ahead 14 years, he observes changes in women's fashion. Jumping ahead 40, he meets David's son (also Young) amid a terrible war. Finally, he travels thousands of years ahead to discover a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by humanoid Eloi and the monstrous Morlocks that feed on them.
The duo plan to lure the Wizard from his secret lair.

Headstrong doctor James Kildare (Lew Ayres) and his fiancée, Mary Lamont (Laraine Day), are visited by Mary's brother, Douglas (Robert Young), shortly before their wedding. Douglas, in town for a meeting with a wealthy philanthropist to fund his education project, begins exhibiting bizarre symptoms that Kildare diagnoses as severe epilepsy. Mary's concern for her beloved brother causes her to question whether she should marry Kildare or devote herself to Douglas' care.
A dog finds shelter with a skunk during a snow storm.
Pepé le Pew pursues a cat by the seaside, under the sea and on a desert island.
A jazz drummer (Mickey Rooney) back from Korea meets a cigarette girl (Sally Forrest) and mobsters on Hollywood's Sunset Strip.

Private investigator Philip Marlowe (Humphrey Bogart) is hired by General Sternwood to help resolve the gambling debts of his wild young daughter, Carmen (Martha Vickers). Sternwood's older daughter, Vivian (Lauren Bacall), provides assistance when she implies that the situation is more complex, and also involves casino owner (John Ridgely) and a recently disappeared family friend. As people linked to the Sternwoods start being murdered, Marlowe finds himself getting ever deeper into the case.

Merchant Marine sailors Joe Rossi (Humphrey Bogart) and Steve Jarvis (Raymond Massey) are charged with getting a supply vessel to Russian allies as part of a sea convoy. When the group of ships comes under attack from a German U-boat, Rossi and Jarvis navigate through dangerous waters to evade Nazi naval forces. Though their mission across the Atlantic is extremely treacherous, they are motivated by the opportunity to strike back at the Germans, who sank one of their earlier ships.

Wandering gunfighter Joe arrives in the Mexican village of San Miguel in the midst of a power struggle among sheriff John Baxter and the three Rojo brothers. When a regiment of Mexican soldiers bearing gold is waylaid by the Rojo brothers, Joe is hired by Esteban to join the gang, but he plays one side against the other.

On an unforgiving, snow-swept frontier, a group of bloodthirsty bounty hunters, led by the vicious Loco, preys on a band of persecuted outlaws who have taken to the hills. As the price on each head is collected one-by-one, only a mute gunslinger named Silence stands between the innocent refugees and the greed and corruption that the bounty hunters represent. But in this harsh, brutal world, the lines between right and wrong aren't always clear and good doesn't always triumph.

Jesuit priest Father Gabriel enters the Guaraní lands in South America with the purpose of converting the natives to Christianity. He soon builds a mission, where he is joined by Rodrigo Mendoza, a reformed slave trader seeking redemption. When a treaty transfers the land from Spain to Portugal, the Portuguese government wants to capture the natives for slave labor. Mendoza and Gabriel resolve to defend the mission, but disagree on how to accomplish the task.

Paratrooper commander Colonel Mathieu (Jean Martin), a former French Resistance fighter during World War II, is sent to 1950s Algeria to reinforce efforts to squelch the uprisings of the Algerian War. There he faces Ali la Pointe (Brahim Haggiag), a former petty criminal who, as the leader of the Algerian Front de Libération Nationale, directs terror strategies against the colonial French government occupation. As each side resorts to ever-increasing brutality, no violent act is too unthinkable.

Scientist H.G. Wells builds a time machine, and despite the warning from his friend David against "tempting the laws of providence," decides to visit the future. Jumping ahead 14 years, he observes changes in women's fashion. Jumping ahead 40, he meets David's son (also Young) amid a terrible war. Finally, he travels thousands of years ahead to discover a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by humanoid Eloi and the monstrous Morlocks that feed on them.
The duo plan to lure the Wizard from his secret lair.

Headstrong doctor James Kildare (Lew Ayres) and his fiancée, Mary Lamont (Laraine Day), are visited by Mary's brother, Douglas (Robert Young), shortly before their wedding. Douglas, in town for a meeting with a wealthy philanthropist to fund his education project, begins exhibiting bizarre symptoms that Kildare diagnoses as severe epilepsy. Mary's concern for her beloved brother causes her to question whether she should marry Kildare or devote herself to Douglas' care.
A dog finds shelter with a skunk during a snow storm.
Pepé le Pew pursues a cat by the seaside, under the sea and on a desert island.

Dos de los tsunamis más mortales jamás registrados son el del océano Índico de 2004 y el de Tohoku en Japón en 2011. Los sobrevivientes relatan experiencias traumáticas mientras científicos revelan sus causas y señales de alerta.

El fin de semana del Día de los Caídos en 2018, casi 25 centímetros de lluvia en dos horas conduce una enorme ola a través del centro de Ellicott City, Maryland, y atrapa a los turistas y dueños de negocios, barre los vehículos y derrumba edificios.
Rodeados por osos negros agresivos y territoriales día y noche, dos sobrevivientes deben competir contra grandes depredadores por recursos en las Grandes Montañas Humeantes de Tennessee.
Una pareja se enfrenta a la implacable selva de Guyana. Deben trabajar juntos para luchar contra jaguares, anacondas, caimanes y más de dos millones de especies de insectos.

El experto en supervivencia Ed se adentra en una selva guatemalteca infestada de serpientes y cocodrilos. Tendrá que tomar medidas desesperadas para proveerse de alimentos, tal y como hacían los mayas que habitaron el lugar en el pasado.
Estas son seis de las más duras prisiones del mundo, a tal punto que hasta los jefes de las mafias y asesinos aprenden el significado del miedo.
En Colorado, un conductor abre fuego y provoca una persecución. Además, en Ohio, un hombre inicia un tiroteo. También, en Florida, agentes buscan a un niño autista desaparecido.
Un hombre que no sabía que tenía una orden de arresto es detenido. Unos oficiales encuentran ladrillos de narcóticos escondidos en lo profundo de un camión.

En Nuevo México, un recluso que finge un ataque cardíaco y ataca a un guardia de la prisión; el sospechoso escapa en la camioneta, llevándose a dos reos más. En Nebraska, una familia que disfruta del 4 de julio es atacada con fuegos artificiales.

El análisis de riesgo selecciona a tres pasajeros y sus historias incoherentes activan una alerta de la Aduana. Los agentes del Ibama localizan a dos viajeras chinas bajo sospecha de transportar artículos prohibidos de la fauna nacional.

En Washington, un oficial fuera de servicio ve a un criminal buscado en una escuela primaria. Los oficiales en Georgia persiguen a una mujer en su automóvil. En Florida, un auto robado choca y el sospechoso huye a un pantano lleno de caimanes.

Las tensiones entre las familias estallan después de que una prueba de supervivencia se lleva a cabo en total oscuridad, y los supervivientes solo cuentan con la luz que sus equipos en la sede generan para que puedan completar la prueba.

Amy, Adam y Chip visitan una isla desolada en las costas de Newport, Rhode Island. Las enfermedades, los desastres y el aislamiento total han permitido que los espíritus se infecten, lo que lleva a informes de actividad paranormal aterradora.
Perseguidos por leopardos agresivos y desprotegidos, Ángela y Chad luchan contra las circunstancias y contra ellos mismos mientras buscan redención en Sudáfrica.
Un hombre cruza con algo que cayó del cielo, así como con los restos de un animal protegido a nivel federal. Los oficiales encuentran a una ama de casa que podría dedicarse a la venta de pastillas.

Teresa conversa con el Batman sin darse cuenta de que alguien la espía. El Italiano se lleva a Sofía a una bodega y el pequeño Simón va escondido en el camión.
Epifanio obliga a Teresa a infiltrarse en el cartel del Zurdo Villa, pero antes ella tiene una cita sin censura en las pirámides. Batman organiza su viaje a Sinaloa.
El rescate de Sofía está en riesgo. Pareciera que Teresa ha perdido la cabeza y Oleg está enfurecido con ella. Por su parte, Epifanio sufre las consecuencias del comportamiento de su esposa.
Teresa se lleva una gran sorpresa. La casa donde vivía el Güero Dávila no ha cambiado y eso le preocupa. A escondidas, el jardinero llama a su jefe.

Teresa y el Zurdo Villa se conocen y van a cenar juntos, pero ocurre algo extraño que alerta a Oleg. Por otra parte, Epifanio le ofrece a Carmen un trato para ayudar a su nieta y Lupo lleva a Sofía a una isla.
Teresa va a la fiesta que el Zurdo preparó en su honor. Allá recibe un regalo muy especial del anfitrión, pero ella lo rechaza y su osadía podría costarles la vida a todos.

Former "Extra" correspondent Jon Kelley hosts this comedy game show that features a panel of comedians interacting with two contestants, who have a chance to win cash if they can read between the lines of the comics' jokes. The contestants ask the comedians questions, to which the jokemakers give humorous answers. The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash.

Ex-con Jimmy Cuervo (Edward Furlong) and his girlfriend (Emmanuelle Chriqui) are targeted by satanists, who murder them as part of a ceremony to resurrect the devil. However, a crow brings Jimmy back, and as an invulnerable spirit of justice, he begins hunting down his murderers. While the satanists meet grisly ends one at a time, the leaders, Luc Death Crash (David Boreanaz) and his lover, Lola (Tara Reid), attempt to complete the ritual, which will make them even more powerful than Jimmy.

Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) has come to earth to strengthen his powers by claiming the wicked spirit of a psychotic veteran. The benevolent angel, Simon (Eric Stoltz), want to stop that from happening, so hides the man's spirit where Gabriel would least expect to find it: in a little girl (Moriah Shining Dove Snyder). Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child.

Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) rises from hell to declare war on God and humanity. To win the spiritual war, Gabriel has to kill Los Angeles nurse Valerie Rosales (Jennifer Beals) -- and, more importantly, her unborn half-angel baby. Helping Gabriel track Rosales down is a suicidal teenager (Brittany Murphy). Meanwhile, good angel Danyael (Russell Wong) marshals all his heavenly powers to protect Rosales and her child from Gabriel's clutches.
A lawman (Jason Scott Lee) tries to protect a young woman (Kari Wuhrer) who possesses a book that inhabitants of heaven and hell want.

A documentary following the decades-long crusade of investigative journalist Andrew Jennings to expose corruption inside FIFA, football's sole governing body and the largest sports organization in the world.

When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today.

After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice.

The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven (Brandon Lee) and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent inner-city gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the gothic mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger. Tracking down the thugs responsible for the crimes and mercilessly murdering them, Eric eventually confronts head gangster Top Dollar (Michael Wincott) to complete his macabre mission.

After mechanic Ashe (Vincent Perez) and his son (Eric Acosta) witness a murder, they are captured and killed by drug lord Judah (Richard Brooks). Soon, a young artist named Sarah (Mia Kirshner) meets Ashe, who has just returned from the dead. Sarah, who had known a man resurrected into the vengeful warrior the Crow years ago, explains to Ashe that he is now the Crow. Ashe sets out to get revenge by slaying Judah and his minions, but Judah discovers the Crow's power and craves it for himself.

Ex-con Jimmy Cuervo (Edward Furlong) and his girlfriend (Emmanuelle Chriqui) are targeted by satanists, who murder them as part of a ceremony to resurrect the devil. However, a crow brings Jimmy back, and as an invulnerable spirit of justice, he begins hunting down his murderers. While the satanists meet grisly ends one at a time, the leaders, Luc Death Crash (David Boreanaz) and his lover, Lola (Tara Reid), attempt to complete the ritual, which will make them even more powerful than Jimmy.

Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) has come to earth to strengthen his powers by claiming the wicked spirit of a psychotic veteran. The benevolent angel, Simon (Eric Stoltz), want to stop that from happening, so hides the man's spirit where Gabriel would least expect to find it: in a little girl (Moriah Shining Dove Snyder). Caught in a cosmic battle in which even Lucifer (Viggo Mortensen) plays a part, a liturgically minded cop (Elias Koteas) moves heaven and earth to protect the child.

Evil angel Gabriel (Christopher Walken) rises from hell to declare war on God and humanity. To win the spiritual war, Gabriel has to kill Los Angeles nurse Valerie Rosales (Jennifer Beals) -- and, more importantly, her unborn half-angel baby. Helping Gabriel track Rosales down is a suicidal teenager (Brittany Murphy). Meanwhile, good angel Danyael (Russell Wong) marshals all his heavenly powers to protect Rosales and her child from Gabriel's clutches.
A lawman (Jason Scott Lee) tries to protect a young woman (Kari Wuhrer) who possesses a book that inhabitants of heaven and hell want.

A documentary following the decades-long crusade of investigative journalist Andrew Jennings to expose corruption inside FIFA, football's sole governing body and the largest sports organization in the world.

When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule.

A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today.

Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.
After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.
Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them.
A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny.

Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.
Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart.

Una nueva toma en la serie clásica de 1970 del mismo nombre, trae a tres bellezas frescas para resolver los casos de difícil millonario Charlie Townsend. La princesa de Park Avenue, que se convirtió en ladrón Abby (Rachael Taylor), la desacreditada policía de Miami Kate (Annie Ilonzeh) y la misteriosa corredora de la calle Eva (Minka Kelly) forman una estrecha amistad, ya que tienen una segunda oportunidad en la vida como detectives en la soleada Miami. Aunque son desconocidos cuando se juntan, una cosa es cierta: que siempre se cubrirán las espaldas unas a otras. Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

Alguien trata de matar a la inspectora Calleigh Duquesne.
Horatio interviene para impedir que un policía participe en un caso cuando un asesino salvaje huye desenfrenado por Miami.
Medusas letales son usadas como armas asesinas; regresa una mujer misteriosa del pasado de Jesse.
Jane y el FBI intentan exonerar a un convicto inocente dos días antes de su ejecución.

p.d: Penny wants to ask Gumball to prom, but his over-the-top expectations push her to find a way to meet them; To save Nicole's family dinner, Richard must retrace his day and uncover what the thing is before disaster strikes again.
Mordecai and Rigby track down a legendary, top-secret meal. Their simple quest quickly escalates into chaos as they face absurd culinary challenges to order the ultimate secret menu item.
Jake's imagination runs wild and Finn has to stop it before it kills them. Finn and Jake chase a mysterious villain who's been stealing gold.
Beast Boy heads back east to visit his family, the Doom Patrol, and they decide to throw a clambake to celebrate.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
p.d: Anais starts ageing prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family. Gumball and Darwin find a diary and race to help its author before she misses a life-changing moment.
A good chicken wing party needs a spicy sauce. / Who doesn't love a secret menu item?
Rigby and Mordecai try to teach a defrosted caveman how to be civilised so he can remain at the park. They also help a former favourite television star hide in the mountains.
A look at what everyday life is really like as a teen superhero when the cape comes off. Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg deal with the usual issues of adolescence while saving the world.

Clarence is a spirited boy who sees the best in everything and tackles the problems of everyday life with enthusiasm alongside his friends, Jeff and Sumo. Dirt fights and secret tree forts are all par for the course for Clarence.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
p.d: Penny wants to ask Gumball to prom, but his over-the-top expectations push her to find a way to meet them. Gumball and Darwin attempt to make a big impression at the coolest party of the year.
Gumball and Darwin's reputation is challenged, and they really could not care less. Gumball accidentally uploads a video of himself and wants it gone.
Mordecai and Rigby can't sleep because of the beep. The guys call an old friend to get the party started.
Rigby and Mordecai scramble to find a new limo when they accidentally stain Mr Maellard's limo by eating meatball subs and cannot clean it up. Mordecai is eager to escort Margaret to the airport.
Join the CBBC crew for all your favourite programmes. Tune into CBBC every day from 7.00am.
The Farmer wants to turn the tree in Shaun's field into firewood. So the flock must take desperate measures to stop their beloved tree getting the chop.

Playtime is over as Danger Mouse battles an army of vengeful soft toys. Pink Dawn's henchman-teddy bear, Snuggles, is bringing cuddly toys to life as rage-filled criminals. Danger Mouse spots the source of Snuggles power, it's Pink Dawn's tiara.

When Olive surprises herself and everyone around her by actually becoming a good cook, Dr Pfooflepfeffer tries to cash in by turning the school canteen into an exclusive and super-expensive dining experience.

p.t: Boy Girl Dog Cat Mouse Cheese
p.d: One day the kids answer the door to meet Wedgie. She's Cheese's missing piece from the lab experiment that brought them both to life. Wedgie is happy to have finally found her family, and the kids happily take her in.
News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.
When an old lady realises her umbrella is being used as a hockey stick she seizes the opportunity to score the winning goal.
Patrick wants to be a horse.
The Lemmings have fun jumping on a sheep, until Grizzy gets accidentally shaved.
Duck is working on the check-in desk at an airport and won't allow Frog to check in his enormous suitcase. Will Frog be able to slim it down and catch his plane?
Duck and Frog are sweeping floors in the hairdressers when Frog quickly realises he can make his life easier by borrowing a street sweeper, creating chaos!
Gumball learns that Bobert is planning to take over his identity.
Ivandoe and Bert come across a tiny prince in the forest. Ivandoe has Bert try to kiss the prince.
Joe, Shereen and Stanley bring celebrity guests, music and competitions as part of an interactive entertainment experience catering to a young audience.
The cast of the new UK tour of High School Musical perform a show-stopping song.
Anthony King was a previous contestant, and the first and only one so far to score 180. Now he returns to the show as the guest charity thrower.

The dartboard quiz game that tests contestants darts skills as well as their general knowledge. Three pairs of contestants, consisting of an amateur darts player and quizzer compete for cash and prizes.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

Tim, Sophie, Sarah and Rory work together as a team as they attempt to take down one of the country's finest quiz brains for thousands of pounds.
All that stands between Barry, Joel, Eve and Nick and thousands of pounds is the small matter of one of the country's finest quiz brains.
A team of five friends from Hertfordshire attempt to walk away with a big cash prize.

TV presenters Fiona Phillips and Richard Madeley go head-to-head with the help of experts Charles Hanson and James Braxton, as they go in search of antiques. They travel the entire length of Cornwall starting in Lostwithiel and ending at an auction in Bude.
Bob, Adei and Robert compete to guess the familiar phrases hidden in animated clues and get the chance to win fifty thousand pounds.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.
Five football teammates join forces to take on the Tenable tower as they attempt to win 125,000 pounds for Soccer Aid for UNICEF.
Ross Kemp presents as a team of family and friends, Balaji, Anjali, Bala and Ajit, take on the Bridge of Lies.
Olly, Lucie, Graham and Emma hope that together they can beat the Chaser and leave with thousands of pounds.
Claire Aislewood, Rachel Goodall, Lianne Starns, Rohit Gami, Gordon Wray and Seb Kennedy each challenge the strongest Chasers in a one-on-one contest of wits and trivia to win a big money prize.

Bradley Walsh hosts as 'Doctor Who' actor Colin Baker, Paralympic gold medallist David Weir, actress and 'Strictly Come Dancing' runner-up Chelsee Healey, and comic Alex Horne put their knowledge to the test.

Botox fan Zoe Kellaway hopes to add a bit of sparkle to the competition in Bristol with her 'Pretty in Pink' themed dinner party. Zoe is cooking a predominantly pink menu, including beetroot risotto, and enlists the help of a butler to wear pink hot pants while serving cocktails on arrival. With exploding desserts and plenty of flesh on show, will Zoe succeed in cheering her guests up with her fun theme?

It's the last day of the competition in Bristol, and the turn of highly competitive Andy Wright. Andy is confident that his black-tie dinner party theme and palatial Victorian flat will bag him the cash. He has lined up a glamorous night of champagne, caviar, canapés and candlelight. However, chaos soon descends when Andy burns the nut roast and then loses his star ingredient for the dessert.
Paul and Nicola have finally decided to buy a holiday home in the seaside town of Puerto del Carmen on Lanzarote. Ben Hillman has five excellent options for their budget of £180,000.
Thanks to Dr Frasier Crane, Sam is back on his way to becoming sober and stable again, but Diane, who's taken her old job back, has yet to tell Sam that she's now involved with the doctor.

Frasier asks Sam for some advice about his more intimate relationship with Diane. Sam believes that Diane is still madly in love with him and Cliff catches a vengeful fellow postal employee stealing and must hide from the thief.
During a Halloween party at Cheers, Cliff meets the girl of his dreams. After meeting her in fancy dress he worries she won't like the real him and becomes afraid to see her again as himself.

Sam makes up an elaborate story to explain how he got shot in the rear end, not wanting to tell everyone the real reason. Sam's real reason is that he broke one of his cardinal rules and dated the wife of a very jealous man.

After a PTA meeting Debra makes a comment about a mother who had a breast enhancement and gets upset after seeing Ray's reaction. When Ray returns home from a trip, Debra has a "big" surprise for him.
Ray and Debra have an argument about their new can opener, and Marie, Frank and Robert can't help getting involved.
After an accidental tip-off from Ray which allows him to win a bet, Frank makes everyone suspicious when he begins to show an unusual interest in Ray's work.
Frasier follows Roz to her family home in Wisconsin to pose as her boyfriend, and spare her from embarrassment. Meanwhile, Niles plots to get rid of Daphne's mother.
Niles brings Daphne's hard-drinking dad from England to Seattle in hopes he'll reconcile with his wife, and Frasier obsesses about getting a good report card from his latest romantic partner.

Niles and Daphne marry on an impulse while on holiday in Reno, but are forced to hide their good news on returning to Seattle after learning that Frasier, Martin and Daphne's mother will all be heartbroken if they ever miss the couple's wedding.

Frasier and Niles are pitted against the owner of a local garage in a battle over principles and two dollars, while Daphne leaves the Crane household for the final time, and quickly realises just how much she's going to be missed by Martin and Eddie.
Charged with caring for a calf, Bart is distraught to discover Lou is up for slaughter, and sets out to save him.

Mayor Goodway is left in charge of a class pet, but the hamster escapes.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.

When Thomas and Percy transport an unlucky boxcar of bananas, Thomas starts to have bad luck wherever he goes and must find a way to break the curse.

Pip and Posy wake up disappointed when the snow they expected hasn't come. However, they soon invent ways to have snowy fun without actual snow.

They go up the Empire State Building and see the lights in Times Square. Now they have to get to Hollywood.

Stan, Kyle, Cartman und Kenny müssen einen Vortrag über das Erntedankfest anfertigen. Sie sehen sich im History Channel eine Dokumentation über den Einfluss Außerirdischer daran an und nutzen ihr neu erworbenes Wissen für ihren Schulauftrag.

Er entdeckt eine Seite an sich, die er so noch nie kennengelernt hat. Um zu verhindern, dass der großen Liebe irgendwer in die Quere kommt, ist für Cartman die Zeit gekommen, einer ganz besonderen Person seine Gefühle zu offenbaren.

Butters rastet aus: Es stellt sich heraus, dass seine Eltern Hawaiianer sind. Ihrer alten Tradition entsprechend, schicken sie den Jungen nach Hawaii, um seine Wut durch die Hapa-Noa-Zeremonie zu zähmen.

Die Menschen sehen heutzutage ihre Lieblingsfilme online. Das will Randy Marsh nicht wahrhaben. Er glaubt daran, dass er mit einer Blockbuster-Videothek noch Geld verdienen kann. Doch die Ernüchterung kommt, als die Gäste ausbleiben.

Enttäuscht lassen sich die Southparker ihre "Was würde Jesus tun"-Armbänder entfernen, da ein Forscherteam entdeckt hat, dass Jesus nur deshalb wiederauferstehen konnte, weil er leistungssteigernde Hormone genommen hatte. Nur Stan bleibt Jesus treu.

Lindas Schwester Gayle taucht unangekündigt im Restaurant auf. Sie ist völlig außer sich, weil ihr Date ihr für den Abend abgesagt hat, obwohl sie Karten für einen speziellen Zirkus besorgt hatte. Es handelt sich dabei um einen Katzenzirkus.

Bob ist vernarrt in seinen ferngesteuerten Hubschrauber. Als dieser ohne Grund in seine Einzelteile zerfällt, will Bob vom Hersteller einen Ersatz. Dieser stellt sich jedoch quer. Mit Gene an Bobs Seite gerät die Situation schnell außer Kontrolle.

Bob und Linda wollen ein wenig Zeit zu zweit verbringen und haben ein Date verabredet. Allerdings muss Linda schnell feststellen, dass Bob eine komische Vorstellung von Romantik hat. Louise muss derweil ein Chinchilla hüten - wenig erfolgreich.

Die Kinder müssen an einem Samstag nachsitzen. Doch es ist nicht einfach irgendein Samstag, sondern der Samstag, an dem das Zuckerwatten-Festival stattfindet. Natürlich versuchen die beiden alles, um früher vom Nachsitzen wegzukommen.

Gene gründet mit Tina, Louise, Rudy, Peter und Darryl eine Band. Allerdings sind sie von seinen Qualitäten wenig begeistert und werfen ihn hochkant wieder raus. Gene verfällt in eine Depression und schwört, nie wieder Keyboard zu spielen.

Weil Francine gerne eine große Familie haben will, kontaktiert sie ihre leiblichen Verwandten. Sie will erleben, wie es ist, viele Geschwister zu haben. Außerdem ist Stan von der Sendung American Pickers vollkommen fasziniert.

Steve und Stan beschließen, ein Entsorgungsunternehmen zu gründen. Sie haben immerhin ein Müllauto, das Stan von seinem Vater geerbt hat. Außerdem stellt Roger fest, dass Hayley unglaublich gut Bumper Pool spielen kann, und fördert sie.
Roger gibt sich als Marionette aus, damit Steve beim Talentwettbewerb der Schule gewinnt. Dadurch sticht er Steves Konkurrenten aus. Außerdem versuchen sich Stan, Hayley und Klaus als Imker.

Obwohl zwischen Stan und Hayley Funkstille herrscht, müssen sie zusammenarbeiten: Terroristen haben angedroht, das Stadion der Bazooka Sharks in die Luft zu jagen. Stan und Hayley bilden also ein Team. Außerdem gibt sich Roger als Escort aus.
Die Jungs können es kaum glauben, dass sie ein ganzes Wochenende lang ohne Mutter auf der Farm vom Bruder verbringen dürfen. Die Brüder stellen entsetzt fest, dass Francis sich negativ verändert hat.
Host Michael Kosta interviews actor Andrew Garfield and discusses the film 'The Uprising'.

Elsewhere, Joey wins his first modelling gig as the poster boy for a venereal disease campaign, and Ross competes with his ex-wife to communicate with their unborn baby.

p.t: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler
p.d: The fabrication process begins, and the team begins to see how difficult building a car out of aluminium by hand will be.

p.t: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler
p.d: After almost a year of fabrication, the team starts assembling panels into the shape of a car. The chassis is also made of aluminium, and after a painstaking frame-design process, the two wild shapes are melded together for the first and last time.

p.t: Bitchin' Rides: Road to the Ridler
p.d: The team passes a huge milestone, as the body and chassis are merged with mock-ups of the other major elements of the car.
Henry and Sam explore two sets of sheds in Hampshire, where they find some Japanese bikes and another surprising discovery. Selling their finds proves to be more difficult than expected.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, the pair visit two amazing sets of sheds in the Oxfordshire and Hampshire area. In the heart of Oxfordshire they find rare Minis, 1970s Rollers, and a pristine rally car. The Hampshire sheds are full to the rafters with Japanese bikes, but they come away with a real surprise. Selling their projects on, however, proves to be a real challenge.

Series in which Henry Cole and Sam Lovegrove nose around people's sheds and garages in search of automotive bargains. Today, on the Cornish coast, Henry and Sam spend the day surrounded by vintage vehicles with genteel pedigrees including the first ever Lotus Elan, and a pre-war Sunbeam. In Oxfordshire, Sam falls for a Midget racer - but the restoration is a daunting task.

The boys are in Oxfordshire, and Mark's shed is more of a boneyard for giants. Everything Henry and Sam look at here is oversized and likely overpriced, but Henry likes a tractor in blue and Sam falls for a Midget racer in a hedge.
Carlos finds a partially restored 1969 Camaro in a barn and convinces the owner to give him the job. Can Carlos please his client and his bank balance?
The guys visit an island in search of treasure and strike gold by finding a 1955 Bel Air. Carlos secures a high-end buyer who could make or break his business.
Using a drone, Carlos and his crew find a haul of classic cars in the woods. And Carlos has five weeks to turn a 1970 'Cuda into a $65,000 'Hot Wheels Car'.
Carlos buys a '57 GMC big window truck and a buyer wants it turned into a low-riding hot rod, fast! Plus, he buys an oddly decorated '64 Impala as a quick flip.

Bri and Harry try to define their relationship. A choppy charter has the guests reaching for sick buckets. And during the last beach excursion, the deck team commits their biggest error of the season.
Captain Jason reprimands the deck crew for their mistake. The final night of the charter season sparks an unlikely hook-up and argument between crew members.

Sonic tries to navigate the complexities of life on Earth with his newfound best friend, a human named Tom Wachowski. They must soon join forces to prevent the evil Dr Robotnik from capturing Sonic and using his powers for world domination.

Gordon heads to Pantaleone's in Denver, Colorado, where he meets the Italian restaurant's owner Pete, who is truly stuck in the past. Pete stubbornly maintains that he makes the 'Best Pizza in Denver', based on a review from the 1980s.
Gordon heads to Arvada, Colorado, where husband-and-wife owners Randy and Alexa have allowed their Old Neighbourhood restaurant to fall into utter disrepair.

Gordon heads to Queens, New York, where he finds a family torn apart by the stress of running failing Greek restaurant Kati Allo. Husband and wife owners Manny and Christine are on the brink of divorce, and daughter Evelyn is caught in the middle.
A quick-witted eight-year-old makes life miserable for four high-tech spies trying to recover a top-secret computer chip.

The Simpsons' house has to be fumigated after an ice hockey player gives his termite-infested stick to Lisa, and the only suitable place the family can find to live is in a TV reality show about life in the 1890s.

Someone tries to murder Homer in the steam room at the Stagnant Springs Spa. Needing help from someone who understands the mind of a killer, Chief Wiggum invites Sideshow Bob out of prison to help investigate the case, but has Bob got over his compulsion to kill Bart, and can he work out who Homer could possibly have annoyed enough to provide a motive for murder?

Lisa is upset that Homer doesn't know more about her, so he hires a detective to spy on her, but when Homer fails to pay him, the detective frames Lisa for a crime, and she has to go on the run.
Homer brings the whole family along when he is sent to Italy to pick up a new sports car for Mr. Burns.

A submarine commander leads a secret mission to the Arctic to check reports that Russia is assembling a nuclear arsenal on a remote island. The film is so virulently anti-communist that even a British critic called it a "disgrace and an insult".

Bored with routine duties, he flies off his designated route and spots Serb forces breaching the peace agreement, but they spot him too and down his craft. Behind enemy lines and with the Serbs on his trail, his only hope is that his commander sends in a rescue mission.

David and his dealers set up stall in Newport. Simon Schneider gets squeezed for an accordion, a cute teddy bear finds a new home, and Simon Schneider brings the house down when he pays out nearly ten grand.

James is joined by pal and Michelin-starred chef Mark Jordan, and together they set out to explore the delights of Jersey aboard mini motorbikes. James samples the delights of one of Jersey's most famous exports, the Jersey Royal potato, and he uses them to cook up a squid risotto with a difference. Mark Jordan gets a lesson in oyster shucking, and James discovers an island speciality: Jersey black butter, which he uses to create a delicious sweet treat.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are Queen of Crime Lynda La Plante, Gareth Malone, and Kelvin and Liz Fletcher to provide the chat - we also meet some rare breed Tamworth pigs, Lesley Joseph goes on a safari with a difference, and horticulturalist David Domoney has tips and tricks to get our greenhouses ready for winter.

Prue is joined in her kitchen by Hollywood actress Blake Lively who cooks a kale Caesar salad. Blake reveals that she and her film star husband Ryan Reynolds are big fans of cooking shows, and she suggests a novel use for a hairdryer. Blake also tells Prue how much she enjoys taking cookery lessons in various countries when travelling the world. Prue makes duck breast with celeriac and cavolo nero, while John heads off to Tewkesbury to meet the people behind the town's famous banners.
The latest national and international news.

James Martin creates two great chicken dishes for Natalie Imbruglia, chef Paul Foster makes 'nduja pasta, and James Tanner cooks up a hake and king prawns Kiev. Plus, mixologist Merlin Griffiths serves up three gloriously icy summer cocktails.

p.t: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand [NEW]
p.d: Gary Barlow and Jason Manford continue their camper van road trip through Central Otago, one of New Zealand's most spectacular wine regions. They start the day with a proper Kiwi pie breakfast in the great outdoors, before tramping through wide open trails and across rope bridges with epic mountain views. After a pause for L&P, New Zealand's iconic soft drink, they take on a slippery driving challenge at Highlands Motorsport Park.
The latest national and international news.

James' culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands. He is joined by top Scottish Michelin starred chef Tom Kitchin. Their journey begins with an incredible tour of the castle grounds complete with awe-inspiring views. James kicks off the cooking with his venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Next Tom Kitchin dusts off his wellies and heads into the woods for a bit of wild mushroom foraging.

Francesca Cumani and Ed Chamberlin present coverage of St Leger day live from Doncaster. Today's feature race, the St Leger, is the fifth and final classic race of the flat season where some of the top staying three-year-olds are in action. Supporting races on a superb card include the Champagne Stakes and the Portland Handicap, plus racing from Chester and Leopardstown - where it's day one of the Irish Champions weekend.

The celebrities show their true colours as they face testing individual and team challenges. A mystery box may offer an advantage, but two face the Duel and only one will survive.
Charlie Brooks, Jimmi Harkishin, and Siobhan McSweeney all try to 'say what they see' as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a 50,000-pound jackpot for their chosen charity.
A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.
News from the world of entertainment.
A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.
After reuniting with his long-lost father, Po must train a village of clumsy pandas to help him defeat a supernatural warrior who becomes stronger with each battle.
News from the world of entertainment.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

An unidentified corpse is dragged out of a river, the only clue to its identity being a driving licence found on the body. Frost is intrigued to discover that the owner of the licence is alive and has no connection with the dead man. Meanwhile, the star player of Denton Athletic collapses at a press conference.

When a security guard is killed at Denton Quarry, Frost discovers that the only witness is a young man who claims that the culprits were aliens from a distant planet. Frost's investigation leads him into a murky world of big business and corporate revenge before discovering the true identity of the aliens.
Frost investigates when a couple returning home from holiday find the body of a stranger in their bed, and while tackling a murder case, he accidentally discovers a cache of rare and exotic animals.

Poirot and his old friend Captain Hastings arrive at the headquarters of an archaeological dig in Mesopotamia where an Arab worker has recently been found strangled. Soon, a renowned archaeologist's wife is also found murdered and all those working on the dig are under suspicion.

A local outcast, who was controversially acquitted of murder years earlier, is the latest inductee into a post-operative heart rehab club. Following his arrival, members' dreams of a second chance at life begin to be cut short.

As the owners of Karras Games gather for a murder mystery weekend, the immersive experience takes a puzzling twist when a killer strikes for real. The police's detective skills are put to the test as they are forced to solve this case on their own.

The annual Midsomer Scarecrow Festival takes a grisly turn as bodies begin appearing on poles displayed alongside their straw creations; the investigation reveals rivalries that run deep and shows people will do just about anything to win.

The Midsomer Mummers, an amateur operatic society, rehearses for its charity concert when the body of an unknown man is found in the theatre; the investigation quickly becomes a race to discover who is desperate to take centre stage.

David and his dealers set up stall in Newport. Simon Schneider gets squeezed for an accordion, a cute teddy bear finds a new home, and Simon Schneider brings the house down when he pays out nearly ten grand.

James is joined by pal and Michelin-starred chef Mark Jordan, and together they set out to explore the delights of Jersey aboard mini motorbikes. James samples the delights of one of Jersey's most famous exports, the Jersey Royal potato, and he uses them to cook up a squid risotto with a difference. Mark Jordan gets a lesson in oyster shucking, and James discovers an island speciality: Jersey black butter, which he uses to create a delicious sweet treat.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are Queen of Crime Lynda La Plante, Gareth Malone, and Kelvin and Liz Fletcher to provide the chat - we also meet some rare breed Tamworth pigs, Lesley Joseph goes on a safari with a difference, and horticulturalist David Domoney has tips and tricks to get our greenhouses ready for winter.

Prue is joined in her kitchen by Hollywood actress Blake Lively who cooks a kale Caesar salad. Blake reveals that she and her film star husband Ryan Reynolds are big fans of cooking shows, and she suggests a novel use for a hairdryer. Blake also tells Prue how much she enjoys taking cookery lessons in various countries when travelling the world. Prue makes duck breast with celeriac and cavolo nero, while John heads off to Tewkesbury to meet the people behind the town's famous banners.
The latest national and international news.

James Martin creates two great chicken dishes for Natalie Imbruglia, chef Paul Foster makes 'nduja pasta, and James Tanner cooks up a hake and king prawns Kiev. Plus, mixologist Merlin Griffiths serves up three gloriously icy summer cocktails.

p.t: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand [NEW]
p.d: Gary Barlow and Jason Manford continue their camper van road trip through Central Otago, one of New Zealand's most spectacular wine regions. They start the day with a proper Kiwi pie breakfast in the great outdoors, before tramping through wide open trails and across rope bridges with epic mountain views. After a pause for L&P, New Zealand's iconic soft drink, they take on a slippery driving challenge at Highlands Motorsport Park.
The latest national and international news.

James' culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands. He is joined by top Scottish Michelin starred chef Tom Kitchin. Their journey begins with an incredible tour of the castle grounds complete with awe-inspiring views. James kicks off the cooking with his venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Next Tom Kitchin dusts off his wellies and heads into the woods for a bit of wild mushroom foraging.
