It's a big day at Pottsfield Leisure Centre, there is a new boss in town. Sharon Granger means business and wants to create an advert to bring in more customers and make her mark. She tasks Danny and Mick to make an advert showing the best bits of the leisure centre.

Footballing legend Chris Kamara is coming to the leisure centre to unveil a statue that has been made of him. All Mick has to do is make sure no-one sees it before he arrives and protect it at all costs. This should be an easy task, but with Danny close by and with a football in tow, nothing is as simple as it seems.

Talented artist Satchel has been painting a big mural at Pottsfield which is ready to be unveiled and photographed by the local paper. Shaun the Sheep and his flock turn farm life upside down with wild adventures, sneaky tricks, and nonstop laughs. Bitzer the dog tries to keep order, but Shaun always has a plan!

It's almost time for the ice cream van to pay its daily visit and Bitzer has his heart set on a well-earned treat. However, his work is not done - there's a whole list of chores standing in his way, and he needs his wits about him to get the job done in time.

The Wild Kratts are on a mission to figure out the differences between African and Asian elephants. They soon discover that despite their differences, all elephants have feelings, emotions, and real intelligence.
While in India, the Wild Kratts try to figure out if a Sloth bear is a bear or a sloth. They soon discover unique creature powers of this animal, including special features.

Mark Jordan gets a lesson in oyster shucking, and James discovers an island speciality: Jersey black butter, which he uses to create a delicious sweet treat.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan at Manor Farm are Queen of Crime Lynda La Plante, Gareth Malone, and Kelvin and Liz Fletcher to provide the chat - we also meet some rare breed Tamworth pigs, Lesley Joseph goes on a safari with a difference, and horticulturalist David Domoney has tips and tricks to get our greenhouses ready for winter.

Prue is joined in her kitchen by Hollywood actress Blake Lively who cooks a kale Caesar salad. Blake reveals that she and her film star husband Ryan Reynolds are big fans of cooking shows, and she suggests a novel use for a hairdryer. Blake also tells Prue how much she enjoys taking cookery lessons in various countries when travelling the world. Prue makes duck breast with celeriac and cavolo nero, while John heads off to Tewkesbury to meet the people behind the town's famous banners.

James Martin creates two great chicken dishes for Natalie Imbruglia, chef Paul Foster makes 'nduja pasta, and James Tanner cooks up a hake and king prawns Kiev. Plus, mixologist Merlin Griffiths serves up three gloriously icy summer cocktails.

p.t: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand [NEW]
p.d: Gary Barlow and Jason Manford continue their camper van road trip through Central Otago, one of New Zealand's most spectacular wine regions. They start the day with a proper Kiwi pie breakfast in the great outdoors, before tramping through wide open trails and across rope bridges with epic mountain views. After a pause for L&P, New Zealand's iconic soft drink, they take on a slippery driving challenge at Highlands Motorsport Park.
The latest national and international news.

James' culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands. He is joined by top Scottish Michelin starred chef Tom Kitchin. Their journey begins with an incredible tour of the castle grounds complete with awe-inspiring views. James kicks off the cooking with his venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Next Tom Kitchin dusts off his wellies and heads into the woods for a bit of wild mushroom foraging.

Francesca Cumani and Ed Chamberlin present coverage of St Leger day live from Doncaster. Today's feature race, the St Leger, is the fifth and final classic race of the flat season where some of the top staying three-year-olds are in action. Supporting races on a superb card include the Champagne Stakes and the Portland Handicap, plus racing from Chester and Leopardstown - where it's day one of the Irish Champions weekend.

The massive investigation into the attempted murders of federal judges in 1989, beginning with the killing of Judge Robert Vance.
An aeroplane takes a deadly plunge from the sky and leaves little evidence behind, but a flight data recorder can provide vital clues.

Efren Saldivar confessed to killing 40 to 50 patients over an eight-year period at a Los Angeles hospital by giving them lethal injections of muscle relaxants.
A seal has a mysterious illness, Kayla finds a surprise in an attic full of baby raccoons and a former volunteer makes her debut as a veterinarian.
Explore a different side of the Tasmanian devil, meet a pioneering sea turtle, enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer, and play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull.
Flap around with Banksi the fruit bat, celebrate a pig's rescue-versary, and learn how to speak baboon with Dingani, who has developed a one-of-a-kind kinship with his primate pal Lucy.
Cheetah cub Usana is born with the odds stacked against her, but she is lucky to have an amazing mother that will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe.

In Brazil's Serra da Capivara, a troop of capuchin monkeys welcomes their latest member, baby Chico, who soon explores a forest full of excitement and danger whilst learning key skills that will allow him to survive and thrive.

From the dry plains of the interior come the most recognizable images of Australia, the monolithic red rock of Uluru, the languid, bounding Red Kangaroo. The Arid Heart of Australia is vast and iconic.
Created by titanic forces, the Great Dividing Range separates a thin ribbon of green from the continent's arid heart.
Discover how France, Scotland and Spain's best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species, from wildcats to snakes and beyond.

Two of the deadliest tsunamis ever recorded are the 2004 Indian Ocean Tsunami and the 2011 Tohoku Tsunami in Japan; survivors recount traumatic experiences as scientists shed light on the causes and warning signs of tsunamis.

Follow four families of four different species of primates, the resourceful Beach Troop, the warlike Desert Troop, the disciplined River Troop, and the peaceful Mountain Band. Find out why these primates are among the most successful animals.

Distant cousins of koalas, wombats lead calm lives in the woods of southeast Australia, sleeping the day away in expertly dug burrows and emerging at night to forage for their tough plants-and-roots diet.

For wombats, the mating season is a departure from the solitary lives they tend to favour. While often slow and lumbering, they can be surprisingly energetic when it is time for courtship, including taking part in a ritualised chase.
By looking at water lilies inside the magnificent Palm House, a unique global rainforest in London, David reveals how flowers first began their evolutionary journey some 140 million years ago.
David Attenborough explores the secret life of plants at Kew Gardens, examining everything from an enormous underground specimen to one particular variety that is snappy and carnivorous.

David Attenborough concludes his absorbing journey around London's Kew Gardens as he discovers how some plants have evolved to shed their dependency on water, enabling them to survive in the driest environments.

After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: La brigada de víctimas especiales intenta acabar con una operación de tráfico sexual que esclaviza a mujeres jóvenes; cuando la investigación es detenida por la Tte. Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe), el detective Benson tiene que ser creativo.

Halstead y Manning se enfrentan con dos hermanos, uno de los cuales está en extrema necesidad de un riñón. Un paciente del Dr. Reese llega a una encrucijada. Un niño de 16 años con una condición genética necesita cirugía, pero la madre se interpone.

El Dr. Charles tiene la tarea de evaluar a un paciente como un posible receptor de un corazón. Jeff hace una confesión al Dr. Manning. Dos luchadores de 🥊 [MMA] MMA llegan a Chicago Med en mal estado. El Dr. Stohl vuelve de su año sabático.

Se produce un accidente de tráfico del que es víctima una paciente que estaba esperando un trasplante de corazón, con lo que la cirugía se complica peligrosamente. Además, el agente de policía que arrestó a Maggie llega gravemente herido al hospital.

En una noche muy ocupada, el Dr. Reese enfrenta varios casos de pacientes muertos. April se ve presionada para bajar su ímpetu. El Dr. Charles tiene noticias importantes para el Dr. Latham. Goodwin le pide al Dr. Rhodes que le ayude con un paciente.

Los síntomas de una chica, que cambian rápidamente, tienen a todos perplejos. El Dr. Halstead se ocupa de un caso difícil y el Dr. Stohl es seguido por un equipo que está rodando un video promocional.

Luego de ser mordido por una araña radioactiva, el joven Miles Morales desarrolla misteriosos poderes que lo transforman en el Hombre Araña. Ahora deberá usar sus nuevas habilidades ante el malvado Kingpin, un enorme demente que puede abrir portales hacia otros universos.
Extrañas luces aparecen sobre Los Ángeles y anuncian la llegada de una fuerza extraterrestre maligna que pretende engullir a toda la población terrestre.

Un soldado y una universitaria idealistas se enamoran, pero su amor queda marcado por los múltiples y peligrosos destinos a los que envían a John, el soldado. Durante siete años se comunican habitualmente por carta, pero esto trae consecuencias.

Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

Dos días antes de su boda, Doug y tres amigos viajan a Las Vegas para una fiesta inolvidable y salvaje. De hecho, cuando los tres acompañantes despiertan la mañana siguiente, no recuerdan nada ni encuentran a Doug. Con poco tiempo por delante, los tres amigos intentan recordar sus pasos y encontrar a Doug para que regrese a Los Ángeles para su boda.
Los chicos intentan averiguar quién robó la cuenta del juego en línea de Sheldon.
Amy y Sheldon difunden un chisme como parte de un experimento. Por otro lado, Howard decide dar un gran paso en su relación con Bernadette.
Priya hace uso de sus conocimientos de derecho para tirar por tierra el acuerdo de convivencia de Sheldon y Leonard. Por otro lado, las chicas sacan a bailar a Sheldon.
Raj intenta curar su ansiedad social. Penny espía a Leonard y a su novia a través de Bernadette.
La madre de Howard termina en el hospital después de oír las noticias del compromiso de su hijo con Bernadette.

Bernadette termina su doctorado, lo que impulsa a los chicos a fastidiar a Wolowitz por ser solo un ingeniero. Por otro lado, Raj decide mudarse con Sheldon tras oír a Leonard y Priya en medio de una fantasía de "Viaje a las estrellas".
Alan enfurece cuando Charlie coquetea con su dulce recepcionista, pues sabe que las cosas no terminarán bien.

Los chicos coinciden con una ex maestra de Jake que se convirtió en bailarina exótica luego de un romance con Charlie. Luego, Charlie le da un cuarto y un empleo para ayudarla, pero las cosas se salen de control.
Alan se alegra al enterarse de que Judith echó de la casa a Herb y finge consolarla. En tanto, Herb intenta buscar mujeres con ayuda de Charlie.
Alan hace todo lo posible por escapar de Judith, mientras Herb continúa pidiéndole consejos a Charlie para acercarse a las mujeres.
Charlie tiene problemas para ajustarse cuando su nueva novia lo invita a pasar la noche en su casa. Alan intenta castigar a Jake.
Charlie cubre a Jake cuando desaparece con la hija del vecino. Alan consigue una cita con una chica muy guapa, gracias en parte al carro de Charlie.

El volante de una persona desaparecida lleva a Margaret a un caso sobre una mujer con síndrome de Down. Resurgen personas desaparecidas de casos antiguos de M&A. Sir negocia los términos de su caso. Dhan está más cerca de saber la identidad de Jamie.
Es el primer día de clases en West Valley High, pero las tensiones entre los dos dojos no se han calmado con el final del verano. La rivalidad entre Daniel y Johnny llega a un punto crítico.
